Portfolio Website

A responsive, accessible portfolio built with semantic HTML, modern CSS, and vanilla JavaScript. Features dark/light theme switching and smooth animations.

HTML5CSS3JavaScriptResponsiveA11y

Project Overview

This personal portfolio project showcases technical projects, professional certificates, skills, and admin journey. It is redesigned using the Astro framework for rapid loading speeds, SEO optimization, and structured component architecture.

The Problem

Single-page landing pages can become cluttered as text bio, detailed projects, and contact sections expand, reducing readability and load speeds.

The Solution

Evolved the landing page into a structured, multi-page Astro site with static page generation, responsive sidebar navigation, a clean color system, and high-performance assets.

Key Features & Scope

  • Static Site Generation (SSG) for sub-second page rendering
  • OLED-friendly dark theme and minimal light theme with smooth toggling
  • A11y compliant text contrast and keyboard-navigable sidebar
  • Dynamic routing for custom project detail pages
